companies.subsequent_events: 2026-07-27: new $5.5B senior unsecured multicurrency revolver replaces $4.0B 2022 facility (liquidity ~$7.7B incl. upsized revolver). 2026-07-30 priced / 2026-08-06 closed $3.0B senior notes: EQIX $850M 5.000% due 2029-08-15 (99.874%, YTM 5.045%), $650M 5.500% due 2033, $650M 5.800% due 2036; Equinix Europe 2 Financing $850M 5.250% due 2031 (EQIX-guaranteed; swapped to EUR, ~3.95% effective). Proceeds: general corporate incl. refinancing upcoming maturities. Pro forma gross debt ex-leases ~ $22.9B (computed). Q3 dividend $5.16/sh paid 2026-09-16. EMEA 2 JV facility (~$1.1B) due Oct 2026. No rating actions or EQIX equity/ATM issuance found Jul 1-Oct 9 2026 (not exhaustively searched).
companies.covenants_and_key_terms: All senior notes unsecured; revolver unsecured (new $5.5B facility: applicable margin 77.5bp, facility fee 7.0-20.0bp, ratings-based). Financial covenant levels/headroom not retrieved. Management target: net leverage ~3.6x annualized adj EBITDA today; CFO guided leverage to rise ~1 turn by end of 2029 planning period while 'not going to change' leverage discipline. Blended borrowing rate 3.0% (after-tax, incl. hedges), WAM 6.4 yrs (Q1'26: 2.9%/6.5 yrs). % fixed not disclosed in retrieved material (debt almost entirely fixed-coupon notes; revolver/term loans ~nil).
companies.credit_view: Equinix is a high-BBB credit (Baa1/BBB+/BBB+) backed by a diversified interconnection-led retail colocation franchise with ~70% of recurring revenue from owned assets, record 53% adj EBITDA margin and net leverage of 3.6x (company, annualized Q2 incl. finance leases; ~3.9x ex the ~$120M one-off xScale fees, ~3.5x on LTM ex-leases by my computation). Debt is almost all fixed-rate unsecured notes at a 3.0% blended cost with 6.4-yr WAM and a manageable near-term ladder ($0.6B rem-2026, $1.1B 2027), backed by $2.2B cash/ST investments and a new $5.5B revolver. The key risk is the capex step-up ($5-6B in 2026, $5-7B/yr through 2029) against AFFO-after-dividends of only ~$2.5B/yr (dividends ~$2.04B in 2026, ~46% of AFFO), implying ~$3B+/yr of external funding and management's own guide of ~1 turn of leverage creep, plus refinancing at ~5-6% vs a 3.0% book cost. Growing unconsolidated xScale JV leverage and guarantees are an off-balance-sheet watch item. Ratings headroom at Baa1/BBB+ likely narrows through 2028-29 if leverage approaches 4.5x+.

companies.covenants_and_key_terms: Unsecured notes: total unencumbered assets must be not less than 150% of aggregate unsecured debt principal; Q4'25 actual 256% (notes covenant) / 281% (credit facility) - Q2'26 ratio not retrieved. Other financial coverage ratios exist (levels not retrieved). Company metrics 6/30/26: net debt/Adj EBITDA 4.7x (includes finance leases and pro-rata unconsolidated JV debt; Q2 annualized), fixed charge coverage 5.2x, debt+preferred/TEV 22.3%. Weighted average interest rate ~2.99% (supplemental, column header not confirmed); weighted average term to initial maturity 4.4 yrs (4.5 yrs with extensions); ~94% fixed/hedged. companies.credit_view: Digital Realty is a solid BBB/Baa2 credit with positive momentum (Moody's outlook Positive, S&P already BBB+): net debt/Adj EBITDA of 4.7x is a multi-year low, fixed charge coverage is 5.2x, and debt+preferred is only 22.3% of TEV, helped by ~$2.5B of H1'26 ATM equity, which shows a clear equity-first funding policy. Debt is ~94% fixed/hedged at a ~3.0% average cost, but WAM is short at 4.4 yrs and the wall is front-loaded ($0.8B rem-2026, ~$2.2B 2027), so refinancing at current coupons (EUR 2036 notes at 5.125%) will lift interest cost. The main risk is execution and funding of the ~$20B, 1.4 GW pipeline (63% pre-leased) and $4.25-4.75B of 2026 net capex against dividends that consume ~50% of AFFO, so continued equity issuance and JV capital are needed to hold leverage near 5x. Unconsolidated JV debt and $755M of preferreds (treated as fixed charges by agencies) add to effective leverage.
